heading: Settings
hotkeyHint: Press to type, hold to talk
morningHint: At this time every day, the agent plans your day
eveningHint: At this time every day, talk about how the day went
hotkeyHintPressOnly: Press to type. Holding to talk doesn't work on this computer.
speechHint: For holding ⌥X to talk. Runs {{engine}} on this computer; your voice never leaves it.
speechNeedsUv: Needs uv (Python's package tool) installed first.

speechStep.model: Downloading the speech model; this can take a few minutes…

models.automatic: Not picked yet; this one works for now
models.none: No model to use yet. Connect one under Model providers below.
models.backgroundHint: Work Jezo starts on its own, like sorting notes, can use a cheaper or faster model.

providers.title: Model providers
providers.intro: Where Jezo gets its models. Ones running on this computer (LM Studio, Ollama) are found on their own; for the others, paste a key.
providers.localMissing: {{name}} wasn't found. Open it, load a model, then press Refresh.
providers.checkFailed: Didn't work; check the key, the address or the model.
providers.name: Name
providers.addressHint: A server that speaks the OpenAI API; the address usually ends in /v1
providers.importHint: Copies keys, your own servers and the default model from your own pi (~/.pi/agent). It's read only when you press this.

imported.skipped: Didn't import {{names}}: not an OpenAI-style API, or its key comes from running a command.

apple.available: Runs on this Mac, and nothing leaves it. Jezo uses it for small tasks, like naming conversations. It can read too little at once to run a full conversation with the agent.
apple.unsupported-system: Requires macOS 26 or later and an Apple Silicon Mac.
apple.device-not-eligible: Apple Intelligence is not supported on this Mac.
apple.intelligence-disabled: Turn on Apple Intelligence in System Settings, then refresh here.
apple.model-not-ready: Apple Intelligence is still preparing its model. Refresh here once the download finishes.
apple.unavailable: Apple Intelligence is unavailable right now. Check System Settings, then refresh here.
apple.helper-unavailable: The Apple model could not be loaded. Try refreshing, or update Jezo.
apple.noModels: The on-device model will appear when Apple Intelligence is available.

atLogin.title: Open in the background at login
atLogin.hint: Automations run while the computer’s awake, without opening the window first. Quitting Jezo still quits it.
